mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 47 degree temperatures at Verona City Hall under a First Quarter moon. The overnight low will be 40 degrees with no rain expected. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:54 AM, traveling from over Belleville toward the East Northeast.

For our city update, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I this past Thursday, October 15, after reports of erratic driving while transporting students. In other news, the city has updated its zoning and sign ordinances, and residents are reminded to double check their polling locations for upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Looking further ahead, yoga is scheduled for October 19 at Insight Wellness, followed by various trivia nights starting October 20.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department responded on Thursday, October 15, to an incident involving a school bus driver arrested for O W I. Officers confirmed that no students were injured during the event.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, so stop in to enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day, Chocolate Volcano.
